name: Estonian acts: Põhiseadus, Riigikogu valimise seadus, Isikuandmete kaitse seadus

scope.when_absent: no scope note is recorded in this history; not a statement that a change reaches every case

default_reach.rule: no retroactive punishment; otherwise legal certainty
default_reach.meaning: no one may be convicted for an act that was not an offence when committed, and a heavier penalty may not apply retroactively; beyond criminal law, the Supreme Court limits retroactive burdens through the principle of legal certainty
default_reach.authority: Eesti Vabariigi põhiseadus § 23; õiguskindluse põhimõte (§ 10) as applied by the Riigikohus
